title: Downloading an Active Directory Decoy Personality

blocks.text: You can download both default and custom Active Directory (AD) decoy personalities individually as a JSON file.
To download an AD decoy personality:

blocks.item: Go to Miragemaker > Strategy Builder > Active Directory Decoy.
Click the Download icon for the decoy personality that you want to download.

blocks.text: The AD decoy personality is downloaded to your system as a JSON file.
